text:
I've been working on a planner for the past 2 years for people whose day never goes the way they planned it.

I was trying to solve the problem I had with time-blocking, where your day ends up derailed and you give up on it because it takes too long to replan. I have solved with the idea of a cascading calendar. If I move a task down or change its duration it pushes other tasks later in the day.

Since then its kinda grown into my full productivity system for logging my thoughts and planning and documenting my life

https://emberflow.space

You can demo here for free https://demo.emberflow.space/?ref=hn
